why: Which purchases and sales are commercial acts by their object: needed to read whether a sale is a commercial dispute for the commercial section (cpca 531) and for free proof (commercial-code 30); the store holds only article 30 of the Commercial Code's opening book.
Commercial acts by form and by accessory nature (acts of a trader for his trade), same reason as article 2: the section proposal of sale-non-delivery is interpretive without them.
Consumer-protection law (as remembered, law 09-03): whether it gives a consumer buyer special delivery rules or remedies alongside civil-code 364 and 119; not in the store.
Fraud (as remembered, article 372): the boundary between a seller who took the price without intending to deliver and a civil non-delivery claim; not in the store.
